defends: Enablement and adoption is its own labour market. It sits in responsibility area 6 of a governance req and the decoder must not absorb it into the governance role.
source: Agency outreach, Aug 2026. Client anonymized. Recruiter name and contact removed.
practitioner_read: Two jobs: a compliance/strategy advisor and an enablement specialist. (Kathleen Bartin, Aug 2026.)
notes: Verdict is left open on purpose: two markets with a title that says which is the hire is arguable either way. The role count and the presence of the enablement market are what this fixture defends.
